title: Triage
description: Output of the triage role: how big and how reversible a goal is, and which components it touches. The goal.size action turns it into the goal's councils.

impact.description: How much the goal changes what users or the system do: low, medium or high.

reversibility.description: easy: a plain revert undoes it; hard: undoing it needs more work, such as a data migration; irreversible: data or external effects cannot be taken back.

areas.description: The paths or components the goal touches, one entry per component, at least one.

reason.description: Why the goal gets these grades, in a few sentences.
